Regel des Ratgebers: Punkte je Wirkung n: Advisor's rule: points per effect by the focus's lists (Economy Plan and tech tree). The favorable direction (color of the modifier in the game) adds points, unfavorable ones from the same lists subtract; unfavorable ones outside the lists show as a drawback without deduction.

Regel des Ratgebers: die Aktionen mit de: Advisor's rule: the actions with the most points go on the slots; an action with an end is finished first from {}% progress, kept if its progress is unknown; kept if the suggestion has no more points. Actions with a target: the game checks whether a matching target exists (estate as target: satisfaction and power are evaluated). Minister: the person with the highest ability for the action, from a lead of {} points (a swap costs influence).
Regel des Ratgebers: die mögliche Reform: Advisor's rule: the possible Reform with the most points, suggested only if a slot is free.
Regel des Ratgebers: je Achse die Wirkun: Advisor's rule: per axis the effects of both poles are rated; the pole with more points is favorable. The {} axes with the largest lead are shown.
Regel des Ratgebers: je Bereich der best: Advisor's rule: the best suggestion per area, in a fixed order: Cabinet (assigning an action costs nothing), Research, Policy and Privilege (20 Political Influence each), Build, Alliance, Reform (only with a free slot), Rival (only with a free slot), finally a pure minister swap; the first five are on top. Suggestions with a warning (an estate would fall below 50% satisfaction or already has 50% power) are left out. Political Influence is deducted in this order; if it is not enough, “save up first” is shown.
Regel des Ratgebers: je Gesetz die Polit: Advisor's rule: per law the Policy with the most points; the current one stays on a tie. If an estate would fall below {}% target satisfaction (effect new − now), a warning is shown. Laws that cannot be changed (allow) or are locked (locked) get no suggestion.
Regel des Ratgebers: je Stand das möglic: Advisor's rule: per estate the possible Privilege with the most points. If it drops an estate's target satisfaction below {}% or raises the power of an estate that already has {}%, a warning is shown.
